analysis_set.span: All primary comparisons between treatment arms will be on an intention-to-treat basis, that is, according to the group to which participants were randomised and without reference to their actual compliance with assigned treatment.

follow_up.span: After a median of 5.9 years, a primary cardiovascular event had occurred

entry_age.span: Men and women aged ≥70 years living independently in the community

notes: ITT is specified prospectively in the protocol, not confirmed as implemented for the served estimate. The packet contains no held_local HTML results source. The protocol cardiovascular composite excludes coronary revascularization, whereas the served report includes it. Entry criteria restrict participants to independently living older adults without diabetes or dementia; these restrictions narrow the question's population without placing participants outside it.
